name: Dumbbell Front Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rest one end of each dumbbell on your front shoulders with elbows pointed forward.
Brace your core, keep your chest lifted, and unlock your hips and knees together.
Squat smoothly down under control until your thighs drop at least parallel to the floor.
Drive forcefully through your midfoot to stand tall while keeping your elbows elevated.
tips: Keep your elbows lifted throughout the squat so the dumbbells do not pull your torso forward.
Keep your heels grounded and knees tracking over your toes from bottom to top.
